# Basic Flashcard Examples

%% @card
%% @front
What organelle is known as the cellular powerhouse?
%% @back
The **mitochondrion** (mitochondria), which generates most of the chemical energy (ATP).
%% @end

@card #ribosome #protein-synthesis
@front
What is the primary function of ribosomes?
@back
Ribosomes perform **protein synthesis** by translating mRNA into polypeptide chains.
@end
